title: Candice Local Preferences — version 3 proposal
note: WS-34 (WR-018) proposal against WR-010-owned packages/candice-protocol/schemas/preferences.schema.json. Application is the integration/release owner's (manifest 9.4 class 2). v3 restructures the first-run name state: nameAskedAt (flat string) becomes nameAsked { askedAt } (object), future-proofing dismissal/rename state.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. WS-34 migrates integer 2 -> integer 3; the published string version is this lane's proposal to WR-010.

preferredName.description: The user's stated preferred name. Never inferred from the OS username (spec 4). Null until asked.

lastUsedAnswerMethod.description: Remembered convenience only; never a lock (spec 5.1).

reducedMotion.description: Null = follow OS reduced-motion; true = force minimal animation; false = animations allowed (spec 10).

askedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the first-run name question was asked. Null when never asked.

nameAsked.description: First-run name ask state (spec 4: asked at most once per local user).
